component.name: Calepin
component.summary: Fast notes and text editing, with Markdown rendered as you type

description.p: Calepin is a small, native notepad for quick notes, reading and editing. Tabs are saved continuously, so nothing is lost when the window closes, even for notes never saved to a file.

ul.li: Markdown rendered as you type: headings, emphasis, lists, tasks, quotes, code, links and tables
Minimap with search results, smooth scrolling
Any text file opens in plain mode with syntax highlighting
Follows the desktop's light or dark style and accent colour, or the Omarchy theme
